environment: Local production preview; Chromium SwiftShader software renderer
initialCheck: Exact composited screenshot byte comparison failed intermittently on desktop; phone passed.

decodedComparison.unchanged: The equipment, instructor and main camera region were unchanged.

interpretation: The one-level pixel differences at the lower composited edge are evidence of screenshot/compositing variation, not evidence of continued scene animation.
revisedCheck: Compare SHA-256 hashes of every raw WebGL RGBA byte immediately after rendering, and assert more than 10,000 coloured pixels to reject empty buffers. No pixel tolerance is used.
limitations: These checks use a local software renderer and do not establish physical phone or GPU performance.
